name: Arisha Terraces
paymentPlan: 10% down payment at sales launch, 50% during construction, remaining 40% on handover
overview: Arisha Terraces, a gorgeous new residential neighborhood tucked away in the center of Dubai Studio City, is proudly presented by QUBE Development. The 419 well-designed apartments in this contemporary housing complex combine flair and functionality to provide the perfect living environment. Arisha Terraces, which is located in a rapidly growing region of Dubai, provides inhabitants with a fusion of luxury, convenience, and exciting investment opportunities.
